title: What Custom Fields Are
learningGoal: Understand what custom fields are, where they live in LeadProspectrr, and when to use them instead of tags or notes.

items.title: A Data Container
items.description: A custom field is a container you create to store specific information about contacts or opportunities. Think of it as a blank space on a form that you design yourself.

items.title: Examples for Different Businesses
items.description: Speakers: Event Date, Budget Range, Audience Size. Coaches: Coaching Package, Session Count, Assessment Score. Consultants: Project Type, Contract Value, Industry Vertical.

items.title: Contact Records
items.description: Contact custom fields appear on every contact record. They store information about the person: their preferences, history, or attributes.

items.title: Opportunity Records
items.description: Opportunity custom fields appear on deals and sales opportunities. They store information about the specific transaction or project.

items.title: vs Tags
items.description: Use tags to group people. Use custom fields to store specific data values like dates, numbers, or text.

items.title: vs Notes
items.description: Use notes for free-form text and background information. Use custom fields when you need structured, searchable data.

items.title: When to Choose Custom Fields
items.description: Choose custom fields when: you need to filter or search by the value, you want to use the data in automations, the information needs to be reportable, or you need consistent formatting.

keyPoint: Custom fields are structured data containers that store specific information about contacts or opportunities. Use them when you need searchable, reportable, automation-ready data—not for grouping or free-form notes.

actionSteps.title: Identify One Data Point
actionSteps.description: Think of one piece of information you currently track about prospects or clients that would be better in a structured field than a tag or note.

actionSteps.title: Decide the Field Type
actionSteps.description: Would this data work best as text, a number, a date, a dropdown list, or a checkbox?

actionSteps.title: Note Where It Belongs
actionSteps.description: Should this field live on the contact record (about the person) or the opportunity record (about the deal)?

quizzes.question: What is the primary purpose of a custom field?

options.option_text: To group contacts together like tags do
To store structured, specific information about contacts or opportunities
To replace the need for notes entirely

quizzes.explanation: Custom fields are structured data containers that store specific information. They are not for grouping (that's tags) and they complement rather than replace notes.

quizzes.question: When should you use a custom field instead of a note?

options.option_text: When you want to write free-form background information
When you need structured, searchable, reportable data
When you want to add images to a contact record
When you are writing a personal message

quizzes.explanation: Use custom fields when you need data that can be filtered, searched, used in automations, or reported on. Use notes for free-form background information.

quizzes.question: Where can custom fields be created in LeadProspectrr?

options.option_text: On both contact and opportunity records

quizzes.explanation: LeadProspectrr allows custom fields on both contact records (for information about the person) and opportunity records (for information about the deal or project).
